title: AC1021 metric corpus strict refusal on typed proxy graphics
scope: Identify the first strict-output gate for one distinct local AC1021 corpus drawing. This records a refusal and does not qualify proxy-graphics preservation or whole-document support.

source.fixturePolicy: Existing local corpus input; not modified or committed by this investigation.

converter.diagnostic: DXF export preflight failed: typed-proxy-graphics-not-preserved count=2 firstHandle=165230

interpretation: Two typed INSERT proxy caches block strict output. ODA §29 identifies the 15 type-19 chunks as marker-index controls; ezdxf independently reads the marker values and decodes both exact extracted streams to 231 and 259 POLYLINE/TEXT virtual entities. libdxfrw now emits ordered marker callbacks scoped to the source host handle and retains them in the DWG block journal. This does not establish INSERT cache source association, exact DXF output/readback, or native display. The existing fail-closed gate remains correct.
nextAction: Establish whether the source proxy stream is semantically attached to each INSERT or its referenced block, and whether DXF permits exact same-version cache replay for this entity type. Bind output bytes to the source INSERT and block graph, then verify exact group 310 readback and native marker-to-geometry behavior before admitting the profile.
nonClaims: No proxy-graphics semantic or replay support is established.
No whole-document AC1021 conversion support is established.
No source fixture was added or modified.

probe.method: A temporary local C++ probe imported the exact source through dx_iface and enumerated typed entities, provenance and DRW_ProxyGraphicDecoder::inspect results.
probe.result: Chunk histogram: handle 0x2856E has opcode counts 19:7, 22:231, 23:231, 29:1, 31:1, 32:165, 38:66; handle 0x2A974 has 19:8, 22:259, 23:259, 29:1, 31:1, 32:184, 38:75. Opcodes 19, 22/23 and 29/31 are recognized controls; 32/38 are recognized primitive types. The updated source probe reports zero skipped unknown chunks and 471/528 recognized control chunks.

specificationEvidence.source: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1, §29, Proxy Entity Graphics
specificationEvidence.finding: Type 19 is SUBENT_MARKER and its payload is one RL marker index. The spec also defines proxy graphic chunks as RL size, RL type, then type-specific bytes.
specificationEvidence.scopeLimit: This defines the chunk role and wire payload, not whether INSERT proxy caches may be replayed as DXF proxy graphics or how a native consumer should display them.

markerImplementationGap.odaMeaning: ODA §29 says SUBENT items indicate changes for subsequently drawn items; opcode 19 supplies the marker index as RL.
markerImplementationGap.currentDecoder: DRW_ProxyGraphicDecoder reads the 32-bit RL marker, reports marker/control counts, and calls setSubentityMarker before subsequent primitives. The DWG output journal records addProxySubentityMarker(sourceHostHandle, marker) in stream order. Sinks that do not retain markers are counted as unhandled; DWG block decoding refuses that projection.
markerImplementationGap.effect: The local decode/journal path now transports marker identity, but the AC1021 cache's source association and native marker-to-geometry behavior remain unqualified. Strict output remains refused.
markerImplementationGap.requiredEvidence: Bind marker events to their affected following primitives in a consumer, establish the source cache's owner/block role, and verify exact DXF output/readback plus native subentity behavior.

independentDecoderEvidence.finding: The independent decoder names type 19 ATTRIBUTE_MARKER and reads a 32-bit marker index; both extracted streams decode completely to virtual entities.
independentDecoderEvidence.scopeLimit: This is byte-stream decoding only. It does not prove source INSERT-to-proxy semantic association, DXF writer preservation, or native application behavior.
